scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.automation
scripts.test:prompt-golden: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/test_prompt_golden_eval.py
scripts.build:desktop: corepack pnpm build:web && corepack pnpm --dir apps/desktop pack:mac
scripts.dist:mac: corepack pnpm build:web && corepack pnpm --dir apps/desktop dist:mac
